# make_movie_from_raspa_pdb { #mofography.movies.make_movie_from_raspa_pdb }

```python
movies.make_movie_from_raspa_pdb(
    pdb_path,
    cif_path,
    out_html='movie.html',
    max_frames=200,
    frame_stride=1,
    position_decimals=4,
    spacing=0.25,
    isovalue=1.0,
    surf_step_size=2,
    fps=20.0,
    eye=(2.0, 0.0, 1.35),
    center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    up=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
    sidecar=False,
)
```

High-level convenience function to build a fixed-framework movie from RASPA PDB + CIF.
